Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Passenger Alarm Functionality through Passenger Alarm Handle-1: vehicle "In Station" scenario.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Passenger Alarm Functionality through Passenger Alarm Handle-1: vehicle "In Station" scenario.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active with Forward Direction selected.
- vehicle is at Standstill and one side doors opened.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton for Door Release again.
All Doors will be closed and "All Door Close" Green indicator will appear on HMI.

In Passenger Area:
- Activate Passenger Alarm device 41S01
Check Alarm
LED next to the Passenger Alarm device 41S01 starts flashing.
Emergency Brake 1/2 is applied.
Passenger Alarm icon ON in Active Cabin HMI.
Audible Alarm (Buzzer) will start in Active Cabin.
Intercom is Activated between Driver Cab and Passenger area. Verify that Intercom is working normally.
CCTV screen displays the area where PAD handle has been actuated.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, acknoledge the alarm for "Passenger Alarm acknowledgement" (AL41021).
DELETED
LED next to the Passenger Alarm device 41S01 starts glowing continuously.
Alarms Reset.
Audible Alarm (Buzzer) will stop.

In Passenger Area:
- Reset Passenger Alarm device 41S01
DELETED
LED next to the Passenger Alarm device 41S01 switched OFF.
Emergency Brake 1/2 is de-activated.
Passenger Alarm icon disappears from HMI.
Intercom is de-activated between Driver Cab and Passenger area.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Passenger Alarm Functionality when vehicle has just departed: vehicle "In Station" scenario.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Passenger Alarm Functionality when vehicle has just departed: vehicle "In Station" scenario.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active with forward direction selected.
- Sufficient Track Length available for movement.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
-Reset Propulsion, by pressing SIFA PB with the master controller in COAST.
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
vehicle starts moving at slow speed.

In Passenger Area:
- Before 8s time from the start of movement, Activate any  Passenger Alarm device.
LED next to the Passenger Alarm device starts flashing.
Emergency Brake 1/2 is applied and vehicle comes to Standstill.
Check Variable
Passenger Alarm icon ON in Active Cabin HMI.
Audible Alarm (Buzzer) will start in Active Cabin. Check Alarm.
Intercom is Activated between Driver Cab and Passenger area. Verify that Intercom is working normally.
CCTV screen displays the area where PAD handle has been actuated.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, acknoledge the alarm for "Passenger Alarm acknowledgement" (AL41021/AL41022).
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region.
LED next to the Passenger Alarm device starts glowing continuously.
Alarms Reset.
Audible Alarm (Buzzer) will stop.

In Active CABIN:
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
Nothing happens. Movement is restricted.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region.
Nothing happens.

In Passenger Area:
- Reset Passenger Alarm device.
LED next to the Passenger Alarm device switched OFF.
Emergency Brake 1/2 is de-activated.
Passenger Alarm icon disappears from HMI.
Intercom is de-activated between Driver Cab and Passenger area.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Passenger Alarm Functionality when vehicle is in motion: vehicle "Out of Station" scenario.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Passenger Alarm Functionality when vehicle is in motion: vehicle "Out of Station" scenario.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active with Forward Direction selected.
- Sufficient Track Length available for movement.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
-Reset Propulsion, by pressing SIFA PB with the master controller in COAST.
- Move the vehicle for short distance for more than 8 seconds at slow speed and stop.
- Don't open any door.
vehicle is at standstill and doors are closed.

In Passenger Area:
- Activate any  Passenger Alarm device.
Emergency Brake 1/2 is NOT applied.
Check Variable
Passenger Alarm icon ON in Active Cabin HMI.
Audible Alarm (Buzzer) will start in Active Cabin. Check Alarm.
Intercom is Activated between Driver Cab and Passenger area. Verify that Intercom is working normally.
CCTV screen displays the area where PAD handle has been actuated.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, acknoledge the alarm for "Passenger Alarm acknowledgement" (AL41021/AL41022).
LED next to the Passenger Alarm device starts glowing continuously.
Alarms Reset.
Audible Alarm (Buzzer) will stop.

In Active CABIN:
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region and apply service brake.
vehicle stops.

In HMI of Active CABIN:
- Press virtual PB for Door side selection.
- Press virtual PB for Door Release.
- Press virtual PB for Central Opening.
Door will open on the selected side.

In HMI of Active CABIN:
- Press virtual PB for Door Release.
All doors will close.

In Active CABIN:
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
Nothing happens. vehicle does not start movement.
Passenger Alarm icon disappears from HMI.
Intercom is de-activated between Driver Cab and Passenger area.

Test_Cases.name:
In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region.
Test_Cases.description:
In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Reset Propulsion, by pressing SIFA PB with the master controller in COAST.
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region and apply service brake.
vehicle stops.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Fire detection in Propulsion & APS units.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Fire detection in Propulsion & APS units.

test_actions.text:
In Car:
- Simulate Fire detection in Propulsion Unit 
(Using external 1.5 sq.mm. cable, make a short circuit between the terminals 1-2 of resistor 47R01)
Visual Alarm (Fire Indication) will appear on HMI.
Audible Alarm (Buzzer) will sound in Cabin.
LED 47H01 on Desk will glow in both the cabs.
HVAC continues to work normally.
Affected propulsion system is disabled
Check Input
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton for Fire Detection Unit Reset Command.
(As PM_FD_RESET_OPERATIONS=0, the Fire detection system will not be reset).
Check Input
Visual Alarm (Fire Indication) stays on at HMI.
LED 47H01 on desk stays ON in both the cabs.
In active cabina acknowledge the alarm Pop UP
Alarm will change from "Active" to "Acknowldeged".

Forced reset the fire detection system. 
Force output O_OPTO_RESET with AUNIA
Check Input
Visual Alarm (Fire Indication) will disappear from HMI.
LED 47H01 on Desk will be OFF in both the cabs.

In Car:
- Remove the external cable connected between the terminals 1-2 of resistor 47R01
Alarm Reset.

In Car:
- Simulate Fire detection in APS Unit 
(Using external 1.5 sq.mm. cable, make a short circuit between the terminals 1-2 of resistor 47R03)
Visual Alarm (Fire Indication) will appear on HMI.
Audible Alarm (Buzzer) will start in Cabin.
LED 47H01 on Desk will glow in both the cabs.
HVAC continues to work normally.
Check Input
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton for Fire Detection Unit Reset Command.
(As PM_FD_RESET_OPERATIONS=0, the Fire detection system will not be reset).
Check Input
Visual Alarm (Fire Indication) stays on at HMI.
LED 47H01 on Desk will be ON in both the cabs.
In active cabina acknowledge the alarm Pop UP
Alarm will change from "Active" to "Acknowldeged".

Forced reset the fire detection system. 
Force output O_OPTO_RESET with AUNIA
Check Input
Visual Alarm (Fire Indication) will disappear from HMI.
LED 47H01 on Desk will be OFF in both the cabs.

In Car:
- Remove the external cable connected between the terminals 1-2 of resistor 47R03
Alarm Reset.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the SIFA Bypass functionality
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the SIFA Bypass functionality
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward direction selected.
- Sufficient Track Length available for movement.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Operate Sealed Bypass Switch 42S01
Bypass switch operation will be shown on HMI..
Bypass switch operation will be recorded in EVR.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at a speed > 1.5 Kmph
- Release both SIFA pushbutton (on Traction Brake handle) and SIFA pedal.
Nothing happens. vehicle continue to move.

In Active CABIN:
- Apply service brake to stop the vehicle.
-Reset the SIFA BYPASS to its normal position
vehicle stops.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the operation of FWCD System
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the operation of FWCD System
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active with Forward Direction selected.
- Sufficient Track length available for movement.

test_actions.text:
On Track:
- Place the test object (detectable collision element) at about 250 meter on the front of Active Cab.
Nothing happens.

In Active CABIN:
- Take the movement at slow speed towards the test object.
FWCD System detects the object from a distance of about 70 meter.
CDWS Warning Pushbutton  glows (49S01)
Cab Buzzer will activate.
Check Input

In Active CABIN:
- Press the CDWS Reset pushbutton (49S01)
FWCS System Resets and LED 49S01 stops glowing.
Cab Buzzer will de-activate.
Check Input

In Active CABIN:
- Apply service brake to stop the vehicle safely before reaching the  test object.
vehicle comes to standstill.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the alarms of PZB Function.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the alarms of PZB Function.
initial_conditions: - PZB is powered ON  not emergency Brake 1/2 required.
- vehicle is standstill with only Holding brake applied.
- PZB Bypass switch 43S01 is not activated.

test_actions.text:
In Car:
- Operate PZB bypass switch 43S01
Check Alarm
PZB Bypass switch operation will be recorded in EVR.

In Car:
- Reset PZB bypass switch 43S01
Alarm Reset.

In C2 Car:
- Remove the cable 43320.04 from TB 43XT01:72
Check Alarm

In C2 Car:
- Re-connect back the cable 43320.04 in the TB 43XT01:72
Alarm Reset.

In C2 Car:
- Connect  24Vdc to terminal TB 43XT01:74
Check Alarm

In C2 Car:
- Remove 24Vdc to terminal TB 43XT01:74
Alarm reset

In C2 Car:
- Remove the cable 43320.03 from relay terminal TB 43XT01:72
Check Alarm

In C2 Car:
- Re-connect back the cable 43320.03 from relay terminal TB 43XT01:72
Alarm Reset.

In C2 Car:
- Disconnect the cable 43330.03 from relay terminal TB 43XT01:74 and connect it to 43XT01:73
Check Alarm

In C2 Car:
- Disconnect the cable 43330.03 from relay terminal TB 43XT01:73 and connect it back to 43XT01:74
Alarm Reset.
